changes.comment: Fix the `default` export condition, which pointed at `./lib/index.browser.js` — a file this package has no source for and never emits. `default` is the condition every non-Node consumer takes, so browser bundlers, Deno, and edge runtimes could not resolve the package at all; only Node worked, via its own correct `node` condition. It now points at `./lib/index.js`, matching the sibling packages that likewise have a single entry point.
